tagline: Round Otter Tail County, among more than a thousand lakes.
intro: Out of Pelican Rapids the loop runs 150 miles around Otter Tail County, linking Perham, Battle Lake and Fergus Falls through rolling countryside dotted with lakes, stands of woods and farmland.

Battle Lake goes by an anglicized form of Lac du Battaile, the name early French mapmakers gave it, likely for fighting between Ojibwe and Dakota there. Nearby Glendalough State Park spent decades as the game farm of the Minneapolis Tribune's owners, and its lodge put up Eisenhower and Nixon.

moments.title: Pelican Rapids
moments.text: Beside the Pelican River stands Pelican Pete, fifteen feet of concrete and plaster put up in 1957 and claimed as the largest pelican statue in the world.

moments.title: Phelps Mill
moments.text: Royal Powers framed this flour mill on the Otter Tail River without a blueprint, keeping the whole plan in his head, and it ground flour from 1889 until 1939.

moments.title: Inspiration Peak
moments.text: A short, strenuous trail climbs the glacial hill to the view Sinclair Lewis likened to sequins fallen on an old Paisley shawl, some 50 lakes in a 20-mile circle.
